Cost: 3,000eb (Luxury)
Type: Cyberarm (Foundational)
Install: Mall
Humanity Loss: None
Option Slots: uses 1, provides 1

An oversized Battleglove (CP:R, p. 347) covering the forearm and hand. The covered hand can't be used for anything while it's worn. It comes with 2 non-removable Popup Ranged Weapons, with no weapons in them, and 1 more Option Slot for Cyberarm or Cyberlimb Options, but takes no Cyberhands or Cyberhand Options. While worn, options stored in it are usable. Brawling and Martial Arts attacks with that arm take -4. Weapons installed in its Popup Ranged Weapons, supplied by the user, aren't permanent: swapping one needs a DV17 Weaponstech check and 4 hours. Putting it on or taking it off is an Action. A Cyberarm option costs the same to buy and install here as in a Cyberarm. Options in the arm underneath are unusable while it's worn. It can't be concealed.

Foundry notes:

  • Worn, not surgically installed: no Humanity Loss.
  • The two built-in Popup Ranged Weapons are described here; install the core system's Popup Ranged Weapon items into it if you want them on the sheet.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Cyberware Alternatives > Battle/Smart Gloves).
